blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Yesterday teaches today. The past of "to be" is was and were. We use was with I, he, she and it. We use were with you, we and they.

The market was high yesterday. The prices were stable last week. Ethan was at the office. Sophie and Ana were in a meeting. It was a good day.

Today is new, but yesterday helps us. We look at today and yesterday. We compare them. Yesterday's lesson is today's step.

items.q: What is the past of "to be"?
items.why: "The past of 'to be' is was and were."

items.q: Which word do we use with "they"?
items.why: "We use were with you, we and they."

items.q: Where were Sophie and Ana?
items.why: "Sophie and Ana were in a meeting."

items.q: The text suggests that the writer thinks the past is…
items.why: Inferência: "Yesterday teaches today" e "yesterday helps us" — o passado é útil.

items.q: The writer would most likely AGREE that…
options: meetings are a waste of time
items.why: Inferência: "Yesterday's lesson is today's step" — ontem e hoje estão ligados.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan comparar o mercado de hoje com o de ontem. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. Let me compare today with yesterday.

Yesterday the market was slow. The prices were low, and the mood was quiet. Not many trades. I was at my desk all day, and it was a long day.

Today is different. The market is busy now. Prices are up, and the volumes are high. Sophie was right. She said the prices were too low yesterday, and today they are better.

Last week we were very busy too. The ship was late on Monday, but the deal was good in the end. It was a great week for the team.

So, yesterday was slow, and today is strong. We learn from yesterday, and we plan for tomorrow. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How was the market yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday the market was slow."

items.q: How are the prices today?
items.why: "Today is different… Prices are up."

items.q: What was late on Monday?
items.why: "The ship was late on Monday."

items.q: The talk suggests that Sophie's opinion yesterday was…
items.why: Inferência: "Sophie was right. She said the prices were too low yesterday" — hoje subiram, ela acertou.

items.q: How does Ethan seem to feel about today?
items.why: Inferência: "today is strong" e "a great week" — ele está otimista.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I was at the office yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The market ___ open yesterday."
items.why: "The market" = it → usamos was.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We ___ busy last week."
items.why: "We" usa were.

items.q: "Prices were lower last week." Last here means…
items.why: Last week = a semana passada, a anterior a esta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Ethan ___ in Brazil last month."
items.why: "Ethan" = he → was.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "You were right about the quote." To be right means to be…
items.why: To be right = estar certo, correto.

items.q: "It was a great deal." A great deal is…
items.why: A great deal = um ótimo negócio.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We look at today and yesterday." To look at something means to…
items.why: Look at = olhar para, examinar.

items.q: "The ship was late this morning." Late means…
items.why: Late = atrasado, depois da hora certa.
